allow: Bash(do sed -i 's/\\\(.*\\\)console\\.log\(/\\1\\/\\/ console.log\(/g; s/\\\(.*\\\)console\\.error\(/\\1\\/\\/ console.error\(/g; s/\\\(.*\\\)console\\.warn\(/\\1\\/\\/ console.warn\(/g; s/\\\(.*\\\)console\\.info\(/\\1\\/\\/ console.info\(/g' "$file")

Bash(do python3 -c " import re import sys with open\(sys.argv[1], ''r'', encoding=''utf-8''\) as f: content = f.read\(\) # 여러 줄에 걸친 console.log, console.error, console.warn 등을 모두 주석 처리 patterns = [ \(r''console\\.log\\\([^;]*\\\);'', lambda m: ''// '' + m.group\(0\).replace\(''\\n'', ''\\n// ''\)\), \(r''console\\.error\\\([^;]*\\\);'', lambda m: ''// '' + m.group\(0\).replace\(''\\n'', ''\\n// ''\)\), \(r''console\\.warn\\\([^;]*\\\);'', lambda m: ''// '' + m.group\(0\).replace\(''\\n'', ''\\n// ''\)\), \(r''console\\.info\\\([^;]*\\\);'', lambda m: ''// '' + m.group\(0\).replace\(''\\n'', ''\\n// ''\)\), ] for pattern, replacement in patterns: content = re.sub\(pattern, replacement, content, flags=re.DOTALL\) with open\(sys.argv[1], ''w'', encoding=''utf-8''\) as f: f.write\(content\) " "$file")
